front.title: Deprecating Expanded ML-DSA and ML-KEM Private Key Encodings

abstract.t: This document updates RFC 9881 and RFC 9935 to require the seed representation when encoding Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA) and Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) private keys for interchange. It deprecates the expanded and combined representations, while permitting their continued support for legacy imports. These changes simplify implementation and improve interoperability by aligning the private- key representation with that used by JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE) and CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE). Internal private-key representations are unaffected.
